evd_title: GPT-4 RR-MCQ macro accuracy was 0.276 and micro accuracy 0.710 on 196 review-revision multiple choice questions
finding: GPT-4 RR-MCQ macro accuracy was 0.276 and micro accuracy 0.710 on 196 review-revision multiple choice questions
P: RR-MCQ: 196 MCQs from 55 reviews of 14 ICLR-2023 papers (CS/ML); 788 aspect labels by 2 grad students
I: GPT-4-0613 two-step (section selection -> MCQ answer), temp 0.3; also GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 pipelines
C: GPT-3.5->GPT-3.5 and GPT-4->GPT-3.5 pipelines; gold answers from review-rebuttal threads
O: GPT-4->GPT-4: macro F1 0.330, micro F1 0.350; macro (exact-match) acc 0.276, micro acc 0.710; GPT-3.5->GPT-3.5 macro acc 0.128
